newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC completes Benchmark share purchase.
newsitem.headline: FCC completes Benchmark share purchase.

text.p: First Capital Corporation (FCC) said on Thursday it had completed its purchase of 20.33 million shares of Benchmark Group Plc for about 32.5 million sterling.

The company said in a statement its subsidiary Alven Pte Ltd acquired the shares from London Capital Holdings Ltd (LCH) and Friends' Provident Life Office, resulting in Alven becoming a 33.73 percent associate of property investment firm Benchmark.
Benchmark is controlled by Hong Leong Co (Malaysia) Bhd.

In a separate statement, Benchmark said it has exercised its options to aquire nine properties from LCH, a wholly owned subsidiary of Friends Provident Life Office for a total consideration of 110.19 million sterling.
Benchmark said of this, 66.29 million sterling was met by the allotment of 41.43 million new ordinary shares of 50 pence each in the company to LCH. The balance would be paid in cash.
Following the allotment to LCH and LCH's sale of 20.33 million shares to Alven, LCH now holds 35 percent of Benchmark's enlarged issued share capital.
